headline: Daily market snapshot 2026-11-03
summary: Market snapshot for November 3, 2026. S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed lower Monday on tech weakness; Dow gained. Futures mixed on midterm election day. VIX elevated at 21.
key_facts: S&P 500 closed 7541.40 (-0.51%) on Nov 2, lowest since July 31
VIX at ~21.15, elevated on election/payrolls event risk
WTI crude ~$96.80, Brent ~$105.08 after 7-8% drop on Iran diplomacy

headline: Stock futures mixed as voters head to polls for US midterm elections
summary: US stock futures were mixed on November 3 as midterm voting opened. Dow futures fell ~0.55% while Nasdaq-100 futures rose ~0.40%. Investors awaited results from the midterm elections alongside AMD earnings and Friday's October payrolls.
key_facts: AMD reports Q3 results after close Nov 3
October NFP report due Friday November 6

headline: Apple reports Q4 FY2026 earnings: $114.5 billion in revenue, up 12%
summary: Apple reported fiscal Q4 2026 (ended September 26) revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12% YoY, and diluted EPS of $2.10, up 14%, both beating estimates. iPhone revenue rose 17% to $57.6 billion and Services hit a record $31.6 billion. Shares fell after hours despite the beat.
key_facts: Q4 FY2026 revenue $114.5B, +12% YoY, beat ~$112.95-113.38B consensus
Guidance: Services growth 8-9% YoY in December quarter
Shares fell after hours despite the beat

headline: Palantir Q3 2026: EPS $0.44 beats, revenue $2.31B beats, but shares fall on booking miss
summary: Palantir reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $0.44 (beat $0.41 est) and revenue of $2.31 billion (+96% YoY, beat $2.17B est), its first quarter with revenue above $2 billion. Despite the beat, shares fell ~3% after hours as total contract value bookings declined 13.5% sequentially.
key_facts: US commercial revenue $984M, +148% YoY, surpassing US government revenue for first time
FY2026 adj FCF guidance raised to $4.8-5.0B

headline: AMD to report Q3 2026 earnings after close November 3; consensus $1.94 EPS on $13.1B revenue
summary: Advanced Micro Devices reports Q3 2026 results after the market close on November 3. Analysts expect adjusted EPS of $1.94-$1.95 on revenue of ~$13.1 billion. Key focus is data center segment growth and Q4 guidance following Intel's disappointing quarter.
key_facts: AMD Q3 2026 results due after close November 3, 2026, call at 5pm ET
Company guided Q3 revenue ~$13.0B ±$300M, non-GAAP gross margin ~56%
Analysts watch data center segment growth and Q4 outlook

headline: Marvell to acquire Lumentum in $115 billion all-stock deal focused on AI connectivity
summary: Marvell Technology agreed to acquire Lumentum Holdings in a $115 billion all-stock deal, paying 4.500 Marvell shares per Lumentum share—a 23.9% premium to the October 28 close. The deal is expected to close in H1 2028 and targets $1B+ in annual cost synergies.
key_facts: Exchange ratio: 4.500 MRVL shares per LITE share
Projected synergies: $1B+ annual run-rate cost savings
Both boards unanimously approved; Lumentum stock -18% after announcement

headline: Lumentum reports Q1 FY2027 earnings: non-GAAP EPS $4.57, revenue $1.26B both beat
summary: Lumentum Holdings reported fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $1.26 billion, up 136% YoY, and non-GAAP EPS of $4.57 versus $4.22 consensus. The company secured a second major NPO/CPO design win backed by purchase commitments exceeding $5 billion. Results overshadowed by the concurrent announcement of Marvell's $115B acquisition.
key_facts: Q1 FY2027 revenue $1.26B, +136% YoY, beat estimates
Second major NPO/CPO design win with purchase commitments >$5B
Marvell acquiring LITE in $115B deal announced same day

headline: IDEXX Laboratories Q3 2026 earnings beat: revenue ~$1.21B, adj EPS $3.96 vs $3.71 estimate, stock +20%
summary: IDEXX Laboratories reported Q3 2026 revenue of approximately $1.21 billion, up ~10% YoY, and adjusted EPS of $3.96 versus the $3.71 consensus estimate. The veterinary diagnostics company raised its full-year guidance, sending shares up ~20%.
key_facts: Raised 2026 full-year revenue and earnings guidance

headline: Inovio shares surge 224% after FDA grants accelerated approval to VOCERYQ for recurrent respiratory papillomatosis
summary: The FDA granted accelerated approval to Inovio's VOCERYQ (INO-3107) on October 30, 2026, the first FDA-approved plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy for recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP) in adults. Inovio shares surged 224% to ~$1.98 on November 2; drug pricing set at ~$115,000/dose ($460,000 for 4-dose regimen).
key_facts: FDA accelerated approval for VOCERYQ (INO-3107) October 30, 2026
Treats adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP)
Confirmatory study still required for full approval
INO shares +224% to ~$1.98 on November 2 (up from ~$0.61)
H.C. Wainwright upgraded INO to Buy

headline: Binance says it has covered 95% of $6.3B North Korean crypto hack; withdrawals resumed
summary: Binance reported it had covered approximately 95% of $6.3 billion stolen in a record-breaking hack attributed to North Korean hackers. The exchange resumed phased customer withdrawals after a temporary freeze and announced full reimbursement via its assets, insurance fund, and a $1B strategic bitcoin reserve. The hack triggered $3.6 billion in net crypto outflows from the platform.
key_facts: $6.3B stolen in hack attributed to North Korean hackers (Lazarus Group cited)
Binance has covered ~95% of stolen assets
Withdrawals resumed in phases after freeze
Full reimbursement pledged via company assets, insurance fund, $1B BTC reserve
Attackers lost ~$119M through poor execution per Bitquery
Largest crypto theft on record in dollar terms

headline: Bitcoin slips to $76,500 as US midterm voting begins; Binance hack and ETF outflows weigh
summary: Bitcoin fell to ~$76,500 on November 3 as US midterm voting commenced, pressured by the $6.3B Binance hack and spot ETF outflows of $399 million. Fear & Greed index at 26 (extreme fear). Analysts flagged $76,000 as key support and $78,500 as resistance.
key_facts: Binance hack $6.3B and ETF outflows -$399M weigh on sentiment
Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $399M in outflows

headline: Ethereum holds ~$2,260 as whale longs surge; $2,200 demand zone in focus
summary: Ethereum traded around $2,260 on November 3, down ~0.65% over 24 hours and ~15% over the past month. ETH had retreated from above $2,650 in October. Whale accumulation of longs observed near $2,200 demand zone.

headline: Oil prices plunge 7-8% as US and Iran signal diplomacy over Strait of Hormuz
summary: Oil fell sharply on November 2 after Washington and Tehran both signaled willingness to negotiate over the Strait of Hormuz. Brent fell to ~$105 and WTI to ~$96.80, down 7-8% on the day, retreating from recent highs above $117. Qatar's proposal centers on an interim reopening of the strait.
key_facts: US-Iran both signal willingness for Hormuz diplomacy
Qatar mediating proposed interim Hormuz opening arrangement
UKMO reported ship struck by projectile in Hormuz on Sunday
OPEC+: Saudi Arabia, Russia and others held December targets unchanged
ANZ forecasts Brent ends 2026 at $105, UBS at $110

headline: Gold near yearly low at $3,915 as oil falls and midterm elections loom; DXY at 101.70
summary: Gold recovered modestly to ~$3,915/oz but remained close to its 2026 low of $3,870 as declining oil prices reduced inflation fears. The dollar index DXY traded around 101.70, EUR/USD near 1.119, and USD/JPY near 158.00 with yen underpinned by intervention risk.
key_facts: Oil decline reduced energy-driven inflation premium in gold

headline: Treasury yields mixed as oil tumbles; 10-year at 4.91%, 2-year at 4.57%
summary: US Treasury yields were mixed on November 2 as oil prices fell sharply and investors awaited midterm results. The 10-year yield dipped ~2 basis points to ~4.91% and the 2-year eased ~5 basis points to ~4.57%, with the curve mildly positive at ~+32 bps spread.
key_facts: Fed held at 3.75-4.00% in October (10-2 vote)
December hike odds at ~73-76% via CME FedWatch

headline: December Fed hike odds at 76.3% from CME futures ahead of November 3 midterms
summary: Markets priced a ~76% probability of a 25 basis point Fed rate hike at the December 2026 FOMC meeting, based on CME fed funds futures as of November 2. The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% in October following September's hike; the next decision is December 8-9.
key_facts: Fed held 3.75-4.00% at October FOMC (10-2 vote)
Fed Governors Cook and Hammack dissented in favor of 25 bps hike in October
Next FOMC: December 8-9, with updated SEP/dot plot

headline: Anthropic IPO: S-1 filed October 26, earliest pricing November 13; $1.5-2T valuation target
summary: Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 with the SEC on October 26, 2026, planning to list Class A shares on Nasdaq as 'ANT'. The roadshow cannot start until November 10 (15 days post-filing), with earliest pricing around November 13. Reported valuation target is $1.5 to $2 trillion.
key_facts: Anthropic S-1 publicly filed SEC October 26, 2026
Ticker: ANT on Nasdaq Global Select Market
Roadshow earliest start: November 10, 2026 (15-day waiting period)
Share count and price range not yet disclosed in S-1
Confidential draft S-1 initially filed June 1, 2026

headline: Deutsche Bank upgrades CrowdStrike to Buy, raises target to $300 on AI-driven cybersecurity demand
summary: Deutsche Bank analyst Brad Zelnick upgraded CrowdStrike from Hold to Buy and raised the price target to $300 from $240, citing AI-led expansion of the cybersecurity market and a potential early hit to the $10B ARR target for FY2030. CRWD shares rose ~3% premarket but gains faded in a broader tech sell-off.
key_facts: Deutsche Bank upgrades CRWD: Hold → Buy
AI products Guardian and SafeMind cited
FY2030 $10B ARR target may arrive early per bank

headline: Morgan Stanley downgrades Coinbase to Underweight, slashes price target 53% to $120
summary: Morgan Stanley cut Coinbase to Underweight from Equal Weight and reduced the price target by 53% to $120, following Coinbase's Q3 2026 revenue decline of 35% YoY to $1.22 billion amid slower trading and Binance hack uncertainty. The bank cut its 2027 revenue forecast by 28% and EBITDA by 47%.
key_facts: Morgan Stanley: Equal Weight → Underweight on COIN
Catalyst: weak Q3, Binance hack uncertainty, softer forward revenue

headline: Loop Capital downgrades Reddit to Hold, slashes target to $100 from $250 on Google license risk
summary: Loop Capital cut Reddit (RDDT) to Hold from Buy and slashed the price target to $100 from $250, warning that Google may not renew its data licensing deal expiring early 2027 as AI tools reduce search traffic to Reddit. Reddit shares plunged over 25% at open after the company also warned Q4 user growth could weaken.
key_facts: Loop Capital: Buy → Hold on RDDT
Google data licensing deal expiring early 2027 at risk
AI tools reducing referral traffic from Google
Reddit warned Q4 user growth could weaken further
Evercore ISI also cut RDDT to In-Line; KeyBanc moved to Sector Weight

headline: NAPCO Security misses Q1 FY2027 estimates with $49.98M revenue; shares fall ~17%
summary: NAPCO Security Technologies reported fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $49.98 million, up 1.7% YoY but below the ~$52-53M consensus. EPS of $0.34 missed the $0.38 estimate. Management attributed the shortfall to timing shifts in distributor purchasing. Shares fell ~17% to $32.66.
key_facts: Fiscal Q1 FY2027 revenue $49.98M, +1.7% YoY, below ~$52-53M consensus
Management: timing shifts in distributor purchasing patterns

headline: Perion Network agrees to be acquired by Affle for ~$420M at $11.70/share, 34.5% premium
summary: Perion Network announced a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Affle 3iL in an all-cash deal at $11.70 per share, representing a 34.5% premium to the October 30 close and an equity value of approximately $420 million. Perion withdrew its 2026 guidance and will not hold Q3 earnings call; it can solicit competing bids.
key_facts: Perion continues to operate under Perion brand as Affle subsidiary
Go-shop provision: Perion may solicit alternative proposals
Q3 results due November 16; no conference call

headline: Hang Seng rises to 23,393 on US-Iran negotiations; Nikkei slips 0.33%, DAX up 0.63%
summary: Asian and European markets closed mixed on November 2. Hong Kong's Hang Seng rose to 23,393.32, supported by US-Iran diplomacy hopes and Ukraine-Russia talk signals. Tokyo's Nikkei 225 slipped 0.33% to 63,081.86 as Kioxia plunged ~16%, while Frankfurt's DAX rose 0.63% to 25,981.09 and London's FTSE 100 gained 0.29% to 10,761.33.
key_facts: Hang Seng 23,393.32, supported by US-Iran diplomacy
Falling oil prices weighed on BP and Ithaca Energy in London

headline: S&P 500 fell ~1% in October, Nasdaq 100 dropped 6.7%; defensive sectors led as AI spending concerns mounted
summary: The S&P 500 declined ~1% in October while the Nasdaq 100 dropped 6.7%, driven by AI capital expenditure concerns and the Hormuz oil shock. Consumer staples outperformed strongly as investors rotated to defensives. Key risks heading into November are midterm results, geopolitics, and rate policy.
key_facts: Defensive sectors led: consumer staples up strongly
AI capex concerns drove big tech selling in October
Iran Hormuz closure elevated energy prices in October
S&P 500 YTD up ~10.2% as of Nov 2 close

headline: OPEC+ holds December production targets unchanged as Saudi Arabia, Russia keep output steady
summary: Seven OPEC+ member countries including Saudi Arabia and Russia agreed over the weekend to hold December 2026 production targets unchanged. The decision came against a backdrop of sharp oil price volatility driven by the Iran Hormuz situation.
key_facts: Seven OPEC+ producers agreed to hold December production targets unchanged
Saudi Arabia and Russia among those holding output steady
Decision taken against backdrop of Hormuz closure oil spike
Brent had reached $117 prior to Iran diplomacy signal

headline: VIX at 21.15 as election week vol premium spills across midterms, refunding and payrolls
summary: The VIX rose to 21.15 on November 3 with the vol curve flat and skew elevated, as implied volatility for the election week priced above one-month implied vol. Premium reflects stacked event risk: midterms on November 3, Treasury quarterly refunding announcement Wednesday, and October payrolls Friday.
key_facts: Election week vol premium spans midterms (Nov 3), Treasury refunding (Wed), October payrolls (Fri Nov 6)
CNBC noted VIX touched highest intraday level since April on Friday Oct 30 before closing at 19.4

headline: October jobs report due Friday November 6; consensus ~55-63K payrolls, unemployment 4.2%
summary: The October 2026 nonfarm payrolls report is scheduled for Friday, November 6 at 8:30am ET. Estimates cluster at 55,000 to 63,000 new jobs with unemployment holding at 4.2%, following September's soft 29,000 reading. KPMG projects just 45,000.
key_facts: October 2026 NFP due Friday November 6, 2026 at 8:30am ET

headline: B.Riley downgrades Lumentum to Neutral, cuts target to $770 on Marvell deal concerns
summary: B.Riley downgraded Lumentum to Neutral and cut its price target to $770 following the announcement of the $115B Marvell acquisition, citing dilution and integration risks. B.Riley also lowered its Marvell target to $275. Stifel also downgraded LITE to Hold while Raymond James upgraded to Strong Buy.
key_facts: B.Riley: LITE → Neutral, PT cut to $770
Reason: dilution and integration risks from $115B deal

headline: Bank of America raises Regeneron price target to $1,030 from $908 on strong pipeline
summary: Bank of America Securities raised its price target on Regeneron Pharmaceuticals to $1,030 from $908, maintaining a Buy rating, citing strong pipeline progress. The implied upside is approximately 11% from prior levels.

headline: Morgan Stanley downgrades Camtek to Underweight, cuts target to $126 from $152
summary: Morgan Stanley analyst Shane Brett downgraded Camtek Ltd to Underweight from Equal Weight and reduced the price target to $126 from $152, citing semiconductor equipment cycle concerns.
key_facts: Morgan Stanley: CAMT Equal Weight → Underweight

headline: KBW downgrades PennyMac Financial to Market Perform, cuts target to $80 from $100
summary: Keefe, Bruyette & Woods downgraded PennyMac Financial Services to Market Perform from Outperform and cut the price target to $80 from $100, citing mortgage rate headwinds and slower originations.

headline: Evercore ISI upgrades Mohawk Industries to Outperform, raises target to $171 from $129
summary: Evercore ISI analyst Stephen Kim upgraded Mohawk Industries to Outperform from In-Line and raised the price target to $171 from $129, citing flooring cycle recovery and valuation.

headline: Binance posts $3.6B net outflows as withdrawals resume following $6.3B hack
summary: Binance recorded $3.6 billion in net crypto asset outflows after restoring customer withdrawals on Sunday following the record $6.3B hack. Fast traders netted approximately $119 million as the attackers lost funds through poor execution during the heist.
key_facts: Binance net outflows: $3.6B after withdrawals resumed
Withdrawals resumed in phases on Sunday November 1
Attackers lost ~$119M through poor execution per Bitquery

headline: Midterm election history: S&P 500 averages +14.1% in 6 months after vote; Morgan Stanley sees geopolitics as bigger driver
summary: Historical data from BlackRock shows the S&P 500 averaged +14.1% in the six months following midterm elections since 1970. However, Morgan Stanley argues that trade policy, geopolitics, and regulatory reform will have greater market impact than the election outcome itself.
key_facts: Historical: S&P 500 avg +14.1% in 6 months post-midterm since 1970
Morgan Stanley: geopolitics and trade policy bigger market drivers than midterm outcome
Post-election risk: potential Iran conflict escalation per Axios

headline: H.C. Wainwright upgrades Inovio to Buy following FDA approval of VOCERYQ; stock up 224%
summary: H.C. Wainwright upgraded Inovio Pharmaceuticals from Neutral to Buy following the FDA's accelerated approval of VOCERYQ for recurrent respiratory papillomatosis. INO had lost 65% of its value earlier in 2026 before the FDA catalyst.
key_facts: H.C. Wainwright upgrades INO: Neutral → Buy
Catalyst: FDA accelerated approval of VOCERYQ
INO had fallen 65% YTD before approval news

headline: Apple full fiscal year 2026: $478.8B revenue (+15%), EPS $8.98 (+20%), record Services at $31.6B
summary: Apple's full fiscal year 2026 results showed revenue of $478.8 billion (+15% YoY) and diluted EPS of $8.98 (+20%). Services hit a quarterly record of $31.6 billion in Q4. iPhone 17 family drove 17% iPhone revenue growth in the September quarter.
key_facts: Q4 FY2026 Services revenue $31.6B, +10%, quarterly record

headline: Kioxia plunges ~16% on Nikkei, drags Tokyo lower on November 2
summary: Tokyo's Nikkei 225 slipped 0.33% to 63,081.86 on November 2, weighed by a ~16% collapse in Kioxia shares. The sell-off in Kioxia, a leading NAND flash memory maker, reflected broader semiconductor sector weakness.
key_facts: Semiconductor sector weakness a global theme

headline: ANZ sees Brent ending 2026 at $105, UBS at $110 after Hormuz diplomacy eases geopolitical premium
summary: Following the 7-8% oil price drop driven by US-Iran diplomacy signals, ANZ forecasts Brent crude will end 2026 around $105/barrel and UBS projects $110/barrel. Both views reflect a partial easing of the Hormuz conflict premium from $117 peaks.
key_facts: Brent had peaked near $117 during Hormuz closure

headline: Palantir milestone: US commercial revenue $984M surpasses US government revenue for first time
summary: Palantir's US commercial revenue reached $984 million in Q3 2026, growing 148% YoY, surpassing US government revenue for the first time. This milestone reflects the company's successful enterprise AI pivot, though total contract value bookings declined 13.5% sequentially, spooking investors.
key_facts: First time US commercial revenue exceeds US government revenue

headline: Coinbase Q3 2026 revenue fell 35% YoY to $1.22B as crypto trading volumes declined
summary: Coinbase reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1.22 billion, a 35% decline from a year earlier, as crypto trading volumes dropped and BTC prices fell. The Binance hack in late October added further uncertainty to the crypto market outlook.
key_facts: Trading volume decline drove revenue drop
Binance hack added macro crypto uncertainty

headline: Apple shares slide after hours despite Q4 FY2026 beat; whisper miss on EPS ex-tariff benefit
summary: Apple shares fell after hours on November 2 despite Q4 FY2026 revenue and EPS beating consensus. The adjusted EPS of $2.10 included a $0.05 tariff refund benefit; ex-benefit EPS of ~$2.05 missed the $2.07 whisper number. Pre-market on November 3, AAPL shares slid further.
key_facts: AAPL Q4 EPS $2.10 includes $0.05 tariff refund benefit
AAPL shares fell after hours despite headline beat

headline: AMD reports Q3 after close today; Intel's disappointing Q3 sets cautious backdrop for chip sector
summary: AMD reports Q3 2026 results after the market close on November 3, following a disappointing Q3 from Intel last week. Investors focus on whether AMD's data center AI chip momentum can outperform the broader semiconductor sector weakness. Data center revenue and Q4 guidance are the key variables.
key_facts: AMD reports Q3 2026 after close November 3
Key focus: data center AI chip segment revenue and Q4 guide
